text: It checks every system that stores, handles or sends a card number.

text: So where should card numbers live, to keep the check small?

text: Put card numbers in one locked room.
prefix: Put card numbers in one locked room.

text: Give every other system a card token instead, never the number.

text: In this system, that room is the card zone, and Timur runs it at the bank.

text: It has its own database, its own keys and its own logins.

text: It has only two doors.
